tests.name: Research starts from real app action, full timeline retains the live computer DOM
Pause holds the exact timeline and resume keeps progress
Every timeline step and source is selectable, with original HTTPS source URLs
Tab keyboard navigation and arbitrary query input are safe and labelled
Navigation cancels running playback and prevents a late result replacing another screen
A real local file produces exact word, line and paragraph counts without HTML execution
Pending file reads cannot replace a later navigation
Invalid types and oversized files are rejected while empty files remain readable
Research command in the composer is routed and negated document commands remain safe
